instruction: Use only provided fact IDs and exact value digests. Separate observed facts, HYPOTHESIS, observable preconditions, exclusions, falsifiable support/refutation, results/costs and source/conflict denominators. Describe a concrete same-box pose/yaw or cross-box resource tradeoff under registered public predicates; state failure conditions. Never invent numbers, independent reviewers, unobserved causes, future boxes, PCT explanations, current absolute action answers, Cxx or rank shortcuts. Do not claim single-attribute causation when several attributes changed. Preserve all negative/neutral/conflicting evidence and UNKNOWN costs. Return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when material is inadequate. General reminders belong in a control or rejection, not a qualified rule. Structural validity is not trusted content approval; all free prose remains PENDING. No retries, repair or sends are implemented.
